milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must enter the workshop building and navigate close enough to the blast_furnace (at spawn-relative 1, 1, 14 on the back wall) while facing it, confirming visual identification. max_distance=10 ensures the player has entered the building (entrance is at Z=4, blast furnace at Z=14, so player must be well inside). facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking toward the blast furnace.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must locate the iron_door in the interior partition wall (at spawn-relative 3, 1, 10). max_distance=8 ensures the player is inside the building near the partition area. facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking toward the iron door, confirming visual identification. The door is at Z=10 in the partition, distinct from the blast furnace at Z=14.
